meta.brief: Requirements of the 2026-11-15 brief (NFL line origination, injuries and depth, leaderboard, site, process)

legend.Done: delivered; the artifact named in evidence exists in the repo
legend.Partial: some of it exists; the missing part is named
legend.Not started: no artifact found in the repo
legend.Blocked: cannot proceed until a named external source or decision exists
legend.Not met: the repo does the opposite of what the brief requires
legend.Not verified: not checked in this session; no status is claimed
legend.Rejected (brief): the brief rejects it; the note states whether the repo complies
